assembler.modification: Only relative import redirected from .basic1048576 to .reference; wrapper validates bounds and operand counts before use.

language.name: LCTLC-WIDE/0.1
language.qualification: Explicit classical execution extension; not accepted by the stock quantum LCTL compiler.
language.source_roundtrip: Retains every instruction field and the raw original JSON header for exact accepted-image roundtrip.

hardening_changes: Bounded instructions, source lines, cells, header nesting, image bytes, memory, output, steps and cooperative wall time
Strict JSON duplicate keys, finite constants, architecture version and integer field types
Reject capability descriptors outside physical memory and invalid stack pointers
Reject surrogate PRINT_CHAR values as defined VM faults
Exact chunked decimal rendering without changing Python global digit limits
Single-use bounded VM instances; output refusal before append
compatibility_limits: No object linker or multi-object relocation compatibility is claimed.
The recovered assembler applies its final width and mode directives to all instructions; this behavior is retained.
Named capabilities gate image loading; they are not per-service authorization checks in the recovered ISA.
Stack PUSH/POP retain the recovered direct-memory stack behavior rather than an invented capability protocol.
Python hosts the ISA execution; the package does not assert native compiler self-hosting.
